texts.preamble: Sanat Singhai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 April, 2015 Wp-4403-2015 (Sanat Singhai Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 29-04-2015 Mr.Praveen Chourasiya, Advocate for the petitioner.
texts.arguments: In this petition, the petitioner has challenged the validity of the order dated 7.2.2015 passed by the Additional Collector by imposing a fine of Rs.40,000/- on the petitioner under the provisions of the Food Standard and Safety Act, 2006. However, he submits that the appellate authority has not been constituted.
texts.respondent_arguments: In this petition, the petitioner has challenged the validity of the order dated 7.2.2015 passed by the Additional Collector by imposing a fine of Rs.40,000/- on the petitioner under the provisions of the Food Standard and Safety Act, 2006.
